title: Home Assistant app build configuration
description: The build.yaml of a Home Assistant app, as the Supervisor reads it.

args.description: Extra build arguments for the Dockerfile.

build_from.description: The base image, as one image or one per architecture.

codenotary.description: No longer used by the Supervisor.

squash.description: Not supported by Docker BuildKit, which the Supervisor builds with.

image.description: An image with an organization and an optional tag, such as ghcr.io/home-assistant/base:latest. Official Docker Hub images are in the library organization, such as library/debian.
